text:
maya: heads-up: release CI failed due to a regen diff that only reordered enum members, but our semver scanner bumped JS SDK minor.

trent: link: <https://ci.internal/ci/2245>. regendiff shows enum order flip, no value changes.

ci-bot: job 2245 failed in step `regen-check`  see <https://ci.internal/artifacts/2245/regendiff.txt>.

sam: ordering-only diffs shouldn't trigger semver changes. our scanner treats any generated-file change as a potential API change.

ops: likely caused by transient dependency resolution (openapi-to-typescript 6.2.x). I can pin the lockfile for the release branch.

maya: two proposals: 1) short-term pin offending dependency and rerun, 2) longer-term: update regendiff to canonicalize ordering (sort enum members/props) when deciding semver.

trent: i'll open a PR to pin to 6.1.x for the patch release branch and add a regression test that runs `yarn regen` in our CI image.

release-bot: note: automations will add `semver: minor` until regendiff logic changes. Manual override possible on pinned PRs.

sam: also add a devex doc guidance: avoid inline snapshots that assert ordering; prefer value-based assertions or sorted snapshots.

maya: thanks. PR up now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/typegen/pull/2580. will revert pin after upstream fix. keeping this thread for release notes.
